reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be any complete finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure and canonical Lebesgue volume,including dimension zero. Let V:E->R be globally twice continuously Frechet differentiable,and let alpha,beta be nonnegative real parameters with alpha>0 and alpha<=beta. Suppose,for every x,v in E,
  (alpha:R)||v||^2<=D^2 V(x)[v,v]<=(beta:R)||v||^2.
Let eta be any strictly positive real number. Define exactly
  mu=volume.tilted(x -> -V(x)),
  d=dim_R E,
  C=((sqrt(2pi eta))^(-1))^d,
  A(y)=C integral_E exp(-V(x)-||y-x||^2/(2eta)) dvolume(x),
  Veta(y)=-log(A(y)),
  R(y)=mu.tilted(x -> -||x-y||^2/(2eta)).
The tilt is the actual exponential-density normalization against its base measure using a real Bochner integral. In particular mu is normalized exp(-V) against volume,and R(y) is normalized exp(-||x-y||^2/(2eta)) against that actual mu. The Gaussian prefactor C is included in the unnormalized Lebesgue convolution A;A itself contains no division by the partition integral of exp(-V).
Then the following two globally quantified conclusions hold simultaneously:
  for every y,v in E,
    ||v||^2/((beta:R)+eta^(-1))<=CovBilin(R(y))(v,v);
  for every y,v in E,
    D(D Veta)(y)[v][v]<=((beta:R)/(1+(beta:R)eta))||v||^2.
The nested derivative first differentiates the continuous-linear-map-valued function y->D Veta(y),then applies v to each of the two directional slots. CovBilin(R(y))(v,v) is the named true centered covariance of the scalar projection <v,X> with itself under the actual measure R(y),with the supplied covariance interpretation in its identity-L2 regime. It is a real scalar,not a pre-supplied covariance matrix or operator.
Both inequalities hold at every y and every v,not just almost everywhere or for unit vectors. The statement has exactly these two conclusion groups. It does not include additional IsProbabilityMeasure or MemLp conclusions for mu or R(y),nor do those appear as separately supplied premises. It also does not include normalization/pushforward identities,strict positivity of A,a separate ContDiff assertion about Veta,a lower Hessian bound for Veta,an upper covariance bound,finite-step kernels or invariance. All measures and functions in the inequalities are fixed by the exact displayed lets. No upper bound on eta or positive-dimension restriction is supplied.
objects: Complete finite-dimensional real-inner-product Borel E;global C2 V;NNReal alpha,beta and positive real eta;actual Hessian of V;canonical volume and actual tilt mu;dimension d,Gaussian prefactor C,actual unnormalized convolution A and negative-log Veta;actual base-mu exponential tilt R(y);true real covariance diagonal;actual nested derivative of Veta.
domains: E complete finite-dimensional real-inner-product Borel,including dimension zero. V,Veta,A:E->R;alpha,beta in NNReal,cast to R where displayed;eta in R with eta>0;d in N. mu is Measure E and R:E->Measure E. All real normalization/convolution integrals are Bochner integrals. CovBilin(R(y))(v,v) is a real scalar covariance bilinear evaluation. D Veta(y):E->L[R]R and D(D Veta)(y):E->L[R](E->L[R]R),evaluated on v then v. No covariance matrix or phase-product norm is supplied.
quantifiers: For every stated E,V,alpha,beta,eta satisfying the hypotheses,define mu,C,A,Veta,R exactly. The conclusion is the conjunction of two statements,each quantifying every y,v in E. The first is a covariance lower bound under R(y);the second is a diagonal nested-Hessian upper bound for Veta at y. No existential potentials,measures,matrices or certificates are selected,and no only-almost-everywhere scope occurs.
assumptions: alpha>0,alpha<=beta with both NNReal;V globally ContDiff R 2;for all x,v the actual Hessian quadratic form lies between (alpha:R)||v||^2 and (beta:R)||v||^2. eta>0. E has the complete finite-dimensional real-inner-product/Borel structures. Tilt,actual integrals,prefactor and covariance interpretation are defined as supplied. No input probability/L2 certificate,nonzero normalization certificate,upper eta bound,critical point or extra positivity/Hessian premise is stated.
conclusion: For every y,v,||v||^2/((beta:R)+eta^(-1))<=covarianceBilin(R(y))(v,v). Simultaneously for every y,v,fderiv R (fderiv R Veta) y v v<=((beta:R)/(1+(beta:R)*eta))*||v||^2. These are the exact two conclusion groups;the same lets define their R,Veta.
scopes: R(y) is an actual exponential tilt of the actual volume tilt mu,not an arbitrary law or a supplied moment object. A is an unnormalized Lebesgue convolution including C and Veta=-log A. The covariance is diagonal scalar-projection covariance in the supplied identity-L2 interpretation;the declaration does not separately expose probability or MemLp conjuncts. Hessian evaluation is nested fderiv in two identical directions and is pointwise for every y,v. No extra smoothness,positivity,normalization,pushforward,lower-Hessian,upper-covariance,algorithm or invariant-law assertion is added. Zero dimension is allowed. No material ambiguity in the stated formulas is present.

Exact smoothed-Hessian upper coefficient is (beta:R)/(1+(beta:R)*eta). alpha only supplies the positive global lower Hessian assumption;the two displayed coefficients use beta and eta. Exact C=((sqrt(2*pi*eta))^(-1))^d with d=finrank_R E. A exponent is -V(x)-||y-x||^2/(2eta);R tilt exponent is -||x-y||^2/(2eta). Veta=-log A includes the prefactor,not an additionally normalized probability-density logarithm. No omitted partition factor,dimension coefficient or unspecified constant appears.
